summary: Comprehensive testing of Staff Mobile View for Quick Wing fleet management app completed. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed after fixing 2 bugs. The 3-tab mobile interface (Home, Bookings, Request Lift) is fully functional for staff/driver role users on mobile viewport.

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Booking submission failed with 'user_name' field required error
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Added user_name field to booking POST request payload

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: Token not found when 'Remember me' checkbox not checked - component only checked localStorage but token was in sessionStorage
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Updated token retrieval to check both localStorage and sessionStorage
